capture_method: Actual UI execution and unaltered full viewport screenshots

entries.query:
-- T01_users
SELECT user_id, first_name, last_name, role, is_active,
       count(*) OVER() AS gesamt
FROM bookbridge.users ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 10;

-- T02_addresses
SELECT address_id, user_id, city, postal_code, country_code,
       count(*) OVER() AS gesamt
FROM bookbridge.addresses ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 10;

-- T03_publishers
SELECT publisher_id, name,
       count(*) OVER() AS gesamt
FROM bookbridge.publishers ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 10;

-- T04_genres
SELECT genre_id, name,
       count(*) OVER() AS gesamt
FROM bookbridge.genres ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 10;

-- T05_languages
SELECT language_id, code, name,
       count(*) OVER() AS gesamt
FROM bookbridge.languages ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 10;

-- T06_authors
SELECT author_id, display_name,
       count(*) OVER() AS gesamt
FROM bookbridge.authors ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 10;

-- T07_books
SELECT book_id, title, isbn, publication_year,
       count(*) OVER() AS gesamt
FROM bookbridge.books ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 10;

-- T08_book_authors
SELECT book_id, author_id, author_order,
       count(*) OVER() AS gesamt
FROM bookbridge.book_authors ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 10;

-- T09_book_copies
SELECT copy_id, book_id, owner_id, condition, max_loan_days,
       count(*) OVER() AS gesamt
FROM bookbridge.book_copies ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 10;

-- T10_pickup_slots
SELECT slot_id, copy_id, weekday, start_time, end_time,
       count(*) OVER() AS gesamt
FROM bookbridge.pickup_slots ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 10;

-- T11_loans
SELECT loan_id, copy_id, borrower_id, status, due_date,
       count(*) OVER() AS gesamt
FROM bookbridge.loans ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 10;

-- T12_loan_proposals
SELECT proposal_id, loan_id, proposed_days, status,
       count(*) OVER() AS gesamt
FROM bookbridge.loan_proposals ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 10;

-- T13_loan_extensions
SELECT extension_id, loan_id, extra_days, status, new_due_date,
       count(*) OVER() AS gesamt
FROM bookbridge.loan_extensions ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 10;

-- T14_payments
SELECT payment_id, loan_id, outbound_fee, return_fee, status,
       count(*) OVER() AS gesamt
FROM bookbridge.payments ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 10;

-- T15_shipments
SELECT shipment_id, loan_id, direction, status,
       count(*) OVER() AS gesamt
FROM bookbridge.shipments ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 10;

-- T16_notifications
SELECT notification_id, recipient_user_id, loan_id, channel, status,
       count(*) OVER() AS gesamt
FROM bookbridge.notifications ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 10;

-- T17_generated_documents
SELECT document_id, loan_id, document_type, status,
       count(*) OVER() AS gesamt
FROM bookbridge.generated_documents ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 10;

-- T18_reviews
SELECT review_id, loan_id, reviewer_id, rating,
       count(*) OVER() AS gesamt
FROM bookbridge.reviews ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 10;

-- Q01 Drei Tabellen
SELECT c.copy_id, b.title, u.first_name AS owner
FROM bookbridge.book_copies c
JOIN bookbridge.books b ON b.book_id=c.book_id
JOIN bookbridge.users u ON u.user_id=c.owner_id
ORDER BY c.copy_id LIMIT 10;

-- Q02 Drei Tabellen
SELECT l.loan_id, c.copy_id, u.first_name AS borrower, l.status
FROM bookbridge.loans l
JOIN bookbridge.book_copies c ON c.copy_id=l.copy_id
JOIN bookbridge.users u ON u.user_id=l.borrower_id
ORDER BY l.loan_id LIMIT 10;

-- Q03 Drei Tabellen
SELECT p.payment_id, l.loan_id, p.status, u.first_name AS confirmer
FROM bookbridge.payments p
JOIN bookbridge.loans l ON l.loan_id=p.loan_id
LEFT JOIN bookbridge.users u ON u.user_id=p.confirmed_by_user_id
ORDER BY p.payment_id LIMIT 10;
